game.name: League of Legends
game.calendar: Canon dates use the Noxian calendar, counted from the founding of Noxus (year 0); fans and the wiki write years before it as BN (Before Noxus) and after it as AN (After Noxus), and the exact length of a Noxian year is unknown.
game.description: League of Legends is set on Runeterra, a world of rival nations such as Demacia, Noxus, Ionia, Shurima and Piltover and Zaun, shaped by ancient wars between god-warriors, the Darkin, the Void and the cursed Shadow Isles. Riot Games tells the canon (Runeterra Prime) through champion biographies, stories and events, and it also runs alternate skin universes such as K/DA and Star Guardian and the Arcane TV continuity.

timelines.name: Runeterra Prime (canon)
timelines.description: The main League of Legends continuity on the world of Runeterra, dated by the Noxian calendar (BN/AN) and told through the Universe biographies, short stories and events.

timelines.name: Arcane (TV series)
timelines.branch_note: Branches from canon Piltover and Zaun history: the show gives Vi and Powder/Jinx, Jayce, Viktor and Silco a new shared backstory (for example, Viktor first meets Jayce after his trial, while canon has them meet at a Progress Day party) and ends with events the game canon does not follow one-to-one.
timelines.description: The Netflix and Fortiche animated series (Season 1 in November 2021, Season 2 in November 2024) about the sisters Vi and Jinx and the conflict between Piltover and Zaun over hextech and shimmer.

timelines.name: K/DA
timelines.branch_note: A contemporary music skin universe, not a branch of Runeterra history. Riot treats it as a separate setting that it shares with True Damage, Pentakill, HEARTSTEEL and DJ Sona.
timelines.description: A modern-day world where Ahri, Akali, Evelynn and Kai'Sa form the virtual K-pop girl group K/DA, with Seraphine as a guest artist. Its history is told through real-world song and skin releases.

timelines.name: Star Guardian
timelines.branch_note: A magical-girl skin universe set in Valoran City, not a branch of Runeterra history.
timelines.description: Teens chosen by the First Star protect the universe from Void beasts and fallen guardians. It is told in seasons released in 2016, 2017, 2019 and 2022.

entities.name: Aatrox
entities.summary: A Darkin who once defended Shurima against the Void. Mortal sorcery sealed him in his sword, and he was the first of the Darkin to break free.

entities.name: Ahri
entities.summary: A fox-like vastaya from Ionia who can charm her prey and take their essence. She travels the world to learn about her lost ancestors.

entities.name: Akali
entities.summary: An Ionian assassin who left the Kinkou Order and her title of Fist of Shadow to fight for her homeland alone.

entities.name: Akshan
entities.summary: A charismatic Shuriman Sentinel who can bring a victim back to life by killing their murderer. He joined the fight against Viego.

entities.name: Ambessa (Arcane)
entities.summary: Mel's mother, a Noxian general who wants hextech weapons to fight the Black Rose.

entities.name: Ambessa Medarda
entities.summary: A ruthless Noxian general and the matriarch of the Medarda family. She is Mel's mother.

entities.name: Anivia
entities.summary: A Freljordian demi-god in the form of an ice phoenix who is reborn again and again to protect the north.

entities.name: Annie
entities.summary: A child mage with great fire magic, raised in the mountains north of Noxus. Her bear Tibbers became a fiery protector when her powers woke.

entities.name: Ashe
entities.summary: The Iceborn warmother of the Avarosans, who wields a bow of True Ice. Her people believe she is Avarosa reborn.

entities.name: Aurelion Sol
entities.summary: A celestial dragon who forged stars. The Aspects of Targon tricked him into servitude so that his power could make Shurima's god-warriors.

entities.name: Avarosa
entities.summary: One of the three Iceborn sisters who united the Freljord. Lissandra sacrificed her and her armies to entomb the Watchers.

entities.name: Azir
entities.summary: The last emperor of ancient Shurima. Xerath murdered him during his Ascension, but millennia later he was reborn as an Ascended and raised his city from the sands.

entities.name: Bandle City
entities.summary: The hidden home of the yordles, reached through paths beyond the material realm. Early yordles founded it around the Bandle Tree in the spirit realm.

entities.name: Bard
entities.summary: A celestial wanderer who keeps the balance between creation and the void beyond it. He is drawn to artifacts of great magic.

entities.name: Bel'Veth
entities.summary: A Void empress made from a devoured city. She plans to remake reality and to overthrow the Watchers that made her.

entities.name: Bilgewater
entities.summary: A lawless port city in the Serpent Isles, home to pirates, monster hunters and smugglers. Outsiders settled it with the consent of the Buhru people in 787 AN.

entities.name: Boram Darkwill
entities.summary: The Grand General of Noxus who ordered the invasion of Ionia. Swain deposed and killed him in 989 AN.

entities.name: Braum
entities.summary: A kind-hearted Iceborn hero of the Freljord who carries a magic vault door as a shield.

entities.name: Caitlyn
entities.summary: Caitlyn Kiramman, Piltover's best peacekeeper and sharpshooter. She often works with Vi.

entities.name: Caitlyn (Arcane)
entities.summary: Caitlyn Kiramman, a Piltover enforcer and Jayce's former lab assistant. She leads a strike team after her mother dies.

entities.name: Camavor
entities.summary: A lost kingdom on an eastern continent, ruled by King Viego. It fell into ruin after the Ruination, and the rest of Runeterra forgot it.

entities.name: Cassiopeia
entities.summary: The youngest daughter of the noble Du Couteau family of Noxus. A tomb guardian's venom turned her into a serpent-like predator.

entities.name: Darius
entities.summary: A Noxian warrior from Basilich who rose to become the Hand of Noxus. He is Draven's brother.

entities.name: Demacia
entities.summary: A lawful, proud kingdom in western Valoran with a strong military tradition. Refugees from the Rune Wars founded it in petricite forests as a refuge from magic, and it is now in turmoil over its treatment of mages.

entities.name: Diana
entities.summary: A Lunari warrior who became the host of the moon's Aspect. She opposes the Solari of Mount Targon.

entities.name: Draven
entities.summary: A showy Noxian executioner and Darius's brother. He helped Swain take power.

entities.name: Ekko
entities.summary: A young genius from Zaun who uses his Z-Drive to rewind time.

entities.name: Ekko (Arcane)
entities.summary: Vi and Powder's childhood friend, who grows up to lead the Firelights.

entities.name: Evelynn
entities.summary: A demon that feeds on pain. She took form from the suffering of the Rune Wars and lures victims with a human disguise.

entities.name: Ezreal
entities.summary: A daring Piltovan explorer who raids ancient tombs and relies on his natural magic gift.

entities.name: Galio
entities.summary: A petricite colossus built to guard Demacia against mages. Strong magic wakes him from his stone sleep.

entities.name: Gangplank
entities.summary: The fallen pirate king of Bilgewater, who wants to take his city back at any cost.

entities.name: Garen
entities.summary: A noble Demacian soldier of the Crownguard family who leads the Dauntless Vanguard. Lux is his sister.

entities.name: Graves
entities.summary: Malcolm Graves, a mercenary and thief who carries the shotgun Destiny. He works with his old partner Twisted Fate.

entities.name: Gwen
entities.summary: A doll brought to life by magic, who fights with the Hallowed Mist and her sewing tools.

entities.name: Hecarim
entities.summary: The Camavoran knight-commander who betrayed Kalista. The Ruination fused him with his horse into a spectral rider.

entities.name: Heimerdinger
entities.summary: Professor Cecil B. Heimerdinger, a yordle inventor and the longest-serving member of the Council of Piltover.

entities.name: Heimerdinger (Arcane)
entities.summary: A founder of Piltover and head of its council who mentors Jayce, Viktor and later Ekko.

entities.name: Helia
entities.summary: The city of scholars on the Blessed Isles that guarded dangerous relics and the Waters of Life. The Ruination destroyed it in 25 BN.

entities.name: Hextech
entities.summary: Technology that harnesses magic through crystals. Jayce and Viktor first made it work in Piltover.

entities.name: Icathia
entities.summary: An ancient mage kingdom in southern Shurima. Shurima conquered it, and when it rebelled it opened a Void rift that destroyed the land.

entities.name: Illaoi
entities.summary: The Truth Bearer of Nagakabouros, a priestess of the Buhru faith in Bilgewater.

entities.name: Ionia
entities.summary: An archipelago of allied provinces known as the First Lands, where the border with the spirit realm is thin. The Noxian invasion scarred it, and factions still fight over its future.

entities.name: Irelia
entities.summary: A young dancer from Navori who turned her art into war and led the Ionian resistance against Noxus.

entities.name: Isolde
entities.summary: A seamstress who married King Viego. She was poisoned by an assassin's blade, and her return as a wraith in the Well of Ages set off the Ruination.

entities.name: Ixtal
entities.summary: A secluded jungle nation of elemental mages ruled by the Yun Tal from Ixaocan. It survived the Void and the Darkin, and later sealed its borders during the Rune Wars.

entities.name: Janna
entities.summary: An ancient wind spirit who protects the poor of Zaun. Sailors first prayed to her in Oshra Va'Zaun.

entities.name: Jarvan I
entities.summary: A Demacian king whom Sion killed with his bare hands at Hvardis.

entities.name: Jarvan III
entities.summary: The king of Demacia and Jarvan IV's father. He was assassinated in 996 AN during the mage revolt.

entities.name: Jarvan IV
entities.summary: The crown prince of Demacia. After his father's murder he vowed to hunt down the rebel mages.

entities.name: Jax
entities.summary: The last of the Kohari, the guards of Icathia. He has wandered for millennia since the Void destroyed his home.

entities.name: Jayce
entities.summary: Jayce Talis, a Piltovan inventor who made the first hextech breakthroughs with his friend Viktor.

entities.name: Jayce (Arcane)
entities.summary: Jayce Talis, the inventor of hextech who becomes a Piltover councilor.

entities.name: Jhin
entities.summary: An Ionian serial killer who treats murder as art. A secret faction in Ionia's government freed him to use as its assassin.

entities.name: Jinx
entities.summary: An impulsive criminal from Zaun who spreads chaos through Piltover with homemade weapons.

entities.name: Jinx (Arcane)
entities.summary: Powder, Vi's younger sister. Silco raised her after her bomb killed Mylo and Claggor, and she became Jinx.

entities.name: K/DA
entities.summary: A virtual K-pop girl group made of Ahri, Akali, Evelynn and Kai'Sa. Riot Games unveiled it at the 2018 World Championship.

entities.name: K/DA Ahri
entities.summary: The leader and founder of K/DA and one of its main vocalists. Her solo song on ALL OUT is 'I'll Show You'.

entities.name: K/DA Akali
entities.summary: The group's main rapper, with the solo track 'The Baddest'. She later started a side project to recruit new talent.

entities.name: K/DA Evelynn
entities.summary: A main vocalist known for her diva attitude. She clashed with earlier groups and wrote alone before she rejoined Ahri to form K/DA. Her solo song is 'Villain'.

entities.name: K/DA Kai'Sa
entities.summary: The group's main dancer, a quiet loner who speaks through movement. Her solo song is 'Drum Go Dum'. In this setting Kassadin is only her dad.

entities.name: K/DA Seraphine
entities.summary: A Chinese-American indie singer in Los Angeles whose posts caught K/DA's attention. She is a guest artist on 'More', not a permanent member.

entities.name: Kai'Sa
entities.summary: The daughter of Kassadin, swallowed by the Void as a child. She survived by bonding with a living Void carapace.

entities.name: Kalista
entities.summary: A Camavoran general who served King Viego and was betrayed. Now she is a specter of vengeance who hunts traitors.

entities.name: Kassadin
entities.summary: A Shuriman guide whose village the Void consumed. He hunts the Void and its prophet Malzahar.

entities.name: Katarina
entities.summary: A Noxian assassin and the eldest daughter of General Du Couteau.

entities.name: Kayle
entities.summary: The daughter of a Targonian Aspect, born during the Rune Wars. She and her twin Morgana protected Demacia until she left the mortal world.

entities.name: Kayn
entities.summary: Shieda Kayn, a shadow assassin of the Order of Shadow who wields the Darkin scythe Rhaast.

entities.name: LeBlanc
entities.summary: The mysterious matron of the Black Rose, who has manipulated Noxus since its earliest days.

entities.name: LeBlanc (Arcane)
entities.summary: The Illusionary Sorceress of the Black Rose, who entangles Mel and fights Ambessa.

entities.name: Leona
entities.summary: A Solari warrior who carries the Aspect of the Sun.

entities.name: Lissandra
entities.summary: One of the three Iceborn sisters. She made the pact with the Watchers and still rules the Frostguard in secret.

entities.name: Lucian
entities.summary: A Sentinel of Light who hunts wraiths with twin relic pistols. He fought to free his wife Senna from Thresh.

entities.name: Lulu
entities.summary: A yordle mage who makes dreamlike illusions and travels with her fairy Pix.

entities.name: Lux
entities.summary: Luxanna Crownguard, a Demacian noble who can bend light and had to hide her magic.

entities.name: Malphite
entities.summary: A being of living stone, born from the last shard of the Ixtali Monolith that fought the Void.

entities.name: Malzahar
entities.summary: A Shuriman seer who believes the Void will save Runeterra.

entities.name: Master Kusho
entities.summary: A Kinkou master who trained Zed and Shen. He faked his death, secretly freed Jhin, and was killed by Zed.

entities.name: Mel (Arcane)
entities.summary: Mel Medarda, a Piltover councilor and Ambessa's exiled heir. She backs Jayce's work and begins a romance with him.

entities.name: Mel Medarda
entities.summary: The heir of the Noxian Medarda family and a skilled politician. She found she had magic after meeting the Black Rose.

entities.name: Miss Fortune
entities.summary: Sarah Fortune, a Bilgewater captain who avenged her family by blowing up Gangplank's ship.

entities.name: Mordekaiser
entities.summary: The warlord Sahn-Uzal, reborn as an iron revenant who built an empire in eastern Valoran.

entities.name: Morgana
entities.summary: Kayle's twin sister, who bound her wings to embrace her human side. She protects the persecuted in Demacia.

entities.name: Mount Targon
entities.summary: The tallest peak in Runeterra and a place of pilgrimage. Those who reach its summit can become hosts for the celestial Aspects.

entities.name: Nagakabouros
entities.summary: The spirit god of the ocean and of motion, worshipped by the Buhru. Illaoi serves it.

entities.name: Nasus
entities.summary: A jackal-headed Ascended scholar of Shurima, and Renekton's older brother. He went into exile after Azir's failed Ascension.

entities.name: Noxus
entities.summary: An expansionist empire that values strength and lets anyone rise by talent. It grew from Noxii tribes that sheltered in the Immortal Bastion during the Rune Wars, and its founding is year 0 of the calendar.

entities.name: Olaf
entities.summary: A Freljordian berserker who wants to die in glorious battle.

entities.name: Ornn
entities.summary: The Freljordian demi-god of the forge, who works under the volcano Hearth-Home. In myth he is known as Ramhaurg.

entities.name: Pantheon
entities.summary: Atreus, once the host of the Aspect of War. He survived when the Aspect died and now opposes the divine.

entities.name: Petricite
entities.summary: A stone that nullifies magic. It sheltered the refugees who founded Demacia, and the Demacians used it to build Galio.

entities.name: Piltover
entities.summary: A rich, progressive city of trade and invention on cliffs above Zaun. It grew around the Sun Gates and is the birthplace of hextech.

entities.name: Poppy
entities.summary: A yordle who carries Orlon's hammer and searches for the Hero of Demacia.

entities.name: Pyke
entities.summary: A Bilgewater harpooner who came back from the deep to hunt those who exploit others.

entities.name: Qiyana
entities.summary: An Ixtali noble with great elemental magic who wants the high seat of the Yun Tal.

entities.name: Rakan
entities.summary: A charming vastayan battle-dancer and Xayah's partner.

entities.name: Rell
entities.summary: A girl the Black Rose turned into a weapon. She escaped and now wants to bring down Noxus.

entities.name: Renekton
entities.summary: An Ascended warrior of Shurima, locked in a tomb with Xerath for millennia. He now hunts his brother Nasus.

entities.name: Rhaast
entities.summary: A Darkin who was sealed in a scythe. Kayn took up the weapon and now fights its corruption.

entities.name: Riven
entities.summary: A former Noxian soldier who left the empire after the chemical attack in Navori. She now seeks redemption.

entities.name: Runeterra
entities.summary: The world in which League of Legends is set. Unknown beings shaped it with the World Runes, and it has both a physical realm and a spirit realm.

entities.name: Ryze
entities.summary: An ancient archmage, once Tyrus's apprentice, who hunts the World Runes to keep them from misuse.

entities.name: Sejuani
entities.summary: The warmother of the Winter's Claw and Ashe's former battlesister.

entities.name: Senna
entities.summary: A Sentinel of Light who was cursed by the Black Mist. Thresh trapped her soul, and she came back as a wraith with a relic cannon.

entities.name: Seraphine
entities.summary: A singer born in Piltover to Zaunite parents. She can hear the souls of others and performs for both cities.

entities.name: Serylda
entities.summary: The third Iceborn sister, who died with Avarosa at the Howling Abyss.

entities.name: Sevika
entities.summary: Silco's right-hand enforcer. She joins the reformed Piltover council after the war.

entities.name: Shadow Isles
entities.summary: Once the Blessed Isles, home of the enlightened city of Helia. The Ruination merged the material and spirit realms there, and the Black Mist now traps the souls of the dead.

entities.name: Shen
entities.summary: The leader of the Kinkou Order, the Eye of Twilight.

entities.name: Shimmer
entities.summary: A purple chemical made by Singed that gives great strength at a terrible cost.

entities.name: Shurima
entities.summary: A desert empire that once spanned a continent, ruled by the Ascended god-warriors. It fell when Azir's Ascension failed, and it is now rising again under the reborn emperor.

entities.name: Shyvana
entities.summary: A half-dragon warrior who saved Prince Jarvan IV and now serves in his royal guard.

entities.name: Silco
entities.summary: A Zaunite crime lord, leader of the Chem-Barons, and Jinx's adoptive father. He was once Vander's brother-in-arms.

entities.name: Singed
entities.summary: A brilliant but amoral alchemist from Zaun, the maker of shimmer and the chemical weapons used in Ionia.

entities.name: Singed (Arcane)
entities.summary: Dr. Corin Reveck, the chemist behind shimmer. He works for Silco and then Ambessa and wants to cure death to save his daughter.

entities.name: Sion
entities.summary: A Noxian warlord who strangled the Demacian king Jarvan I and was later raised from the dead.

entities.name: Sivir
entities.summary: A Shuriman mercenary captain and the last of Azir's bloodline. Her blood restored Azir.

entities.name: Skarner
entities.summary: An ancient brackern who helped found Ixtal and its ruling Yun Tal, and who guards its borders.

entities.name: Star Guardian Ahri
entities.summary: A veteran leader who rebuilt her team after her first squad was destroyed, and returned to Valoran City in Season 2.

entities.name: Star Guardian Akali
entities.summary: Co-leader of Kai'Sa's team in Season 4.

entities.name: Star Guardian Janna
entities.summary: A veteran guardian from an older team who mentors Lux's squad.

entities.name: Star Guardian Jinx
entities.summary: A member of Lux's team in Season 1.

entities.name: Star Guardian Kai'Sa
entities.summary: Co-leader, with Akali, of the new team that defends a Valoran City scarred by Zoe's invasion in Season 4.

entities.name: Star Guardian Lux
entities.summary: A Valoran City High student who leads the first Star Guardian team of the series, with Janna as mentor.

entities.name: Star Guardian Miss Fortune
entities.summary: Ahri's long-time teammate on both her original and later teams.

entities.name: Star Guardian Rakan
entities.summary: A member of Ahri's original team who fell with Xayah and was later redeemed and healed.

entities.name: Star Guardian Xayah
entities.summary: A member of Ahri's original team who fell, came back in Season 3, and was redeemed. She leads her own team in Season 4.

entities.name: Star Guardian Zoe
entities.summary: An ancient guardian whom grief over losing a teammate corrupted into the Twilight Star, the main threat of Season 3.

entities.name: Swain
entities.summary: Jericho Swain, the Grand General of Noxus. He seized power in a coup in 989 AN.

entities.name: Sylas
entities.summary: A mage from Dregbourne who escaped Mageseeker prison with Lux's power and leads a mage rebellion in Demacia.

entities.name: Syndra
entities.summary: A very powerful Ionian mage. She was freed from her prison at Fae'lor in 996 AN.

entities.name: Taliyah
entities.summary: A young Shuriman stoneweaver who trained with Yasuo and went home to protect her tribe.

entities.name: The Ascended Host
entities.summary: God-warriors made by the Shuriman Ascension ritual at the Sun Disc. They ruled Shurima for millennia, and many later became the Darkin.

entities.name: The Avarosans
entities.summary: The most populous Freljordian horde, led by Ashe. She renamed the Ebrataal tribe after her mother's old tribe.

entities.name: The Black Rose
entities.summary: A secret cabal of mages that steers Noxus from the shadows. It began when LeBlanc and Vladimir met during Mordekaiser's reign.

entities.name: The Darkin
entities.summary: Ascended who were twisted by the Void War and the fall of Shurima and turned against the world. The Aspects and mortal mages sealed them into their own weapons.

entities.name: The Firelights
entities.summary: A Zaunite rebel group led by Ekko in Arcane.

entities.name: The Freljord
entities.summary: A harsh northern land of proud warrior tribes. Its ancient history turns on the war between the sisters Avarosa, Serylda and Lissandra, and the tribes still fight over that legacy.

entities.name: The Frostguard
entities.summary: A Freljordian order that Lissandra secretly controls from the Frostguard Citadel. It hides the truth about the Watchers.

entities.name: The Immortal Bastion
entities.summary: The fortress Mordekaiser built at the center of his empire. The Noxii later sheltered in it during the Rune Wars, and it became the heart of Noxus.

entities.name: The Kinkou Order
entities.summary: Ionian warriors who keep the balance between the material and spirit realms. Shen leads them as the Eye of Twilight.

entities.name: The Mageseekers
entities.summary: The Demacian order that hunts and imprisons mages. Sylas was its most famous prisoner.

entities.name: The Order of Shadow
entities.summary: A militant Ionian order that Zed founded during the Noxian invasion. It uses forbidden shadow techniques to drive out invaders.

entities.name: The Sentinels of Light
entities.summary: An ancient order that fights the Black Mist. Lucian and Senna rebuilt it to stop Viego, the Ruined King.

entities.name: The Solari
entities.summary: A sun-worshipping order of Mount Targon. Leona is its holy warrior.

entities.name: The Star Guardians
entities.summary: Young warriors chosen by the First Star to protect the light of the stars. Their power burns bright but often ends in tragedy.

entities.name: The Sun Disc
entities.summary: The great solar structure at the heart of Shurima's capital that enabled the Ascension ritual. It sank under the sands when Azir died and rose again when he was reborn.

entities.name: The Void
entities.summary: A hungry nothingness from beyond reality, ruled by the Watchers. Its creatures, the Voidborn, try to consume Runeterra.

entities.name: The Watchers
entities.summary: Ancient entities of the Void who woke as reality expanded. Lissandra made a pact with them, and they are now entombed in True Ice under the Howling Abyss.

entities.name: The Winter's Claw
entities.summary: A fierce Freljordian tribe led by Sejuani that raids its neighbors to survive.

entities.name: Thresh
entities.summary: Erlok Grael, once a warden of Helia, now a cruel specter who collects souls in his lantern.

entities.name: True Ice
entities.summary: Ice that never melts, used by the Iceborn. Lissandra used it to entomb the Watchers, and Ashe carries a bow made of it.

entities.name: Twisted Fate
entities.summary: A cardsharp and swindler who works with his old partner Graves.

entities.name: Tyrus
entities.summary: A Seeker Adept of Helia and Ryze's master. He survived the Ruination but later tried to use World Runes, and Ryze killed him.

entities.name: Vander (Arcane)
entities.summary: A former rebel who runs The Last Drop and adopts Vi and Powder. Singed later turns him into the beast Warwick.

entities.name: Varus
entities.summary: One of the Darkin, the last to be sealed at the end of the Great Darkin War. He escaped in the bodies of two Ionian hunters.

entities.name: Vayne
entities.summary: Shauna Vayne, a Demacian monster hunter who seeks the demon that killed her family.

entities.name: Veigar
entities.summary: A yordle sorcerer whose curiosity turned dark during his long imprisonment in the Immortal Bastion.

entities.name: Vel'Koz
entities.summary: A cold, curious Voidborn, made as one of the first Void prototypes during the War of the Three Sisters.

entities.name: Vi
entities.summary: A brawler from Zaun with hextech gauntlets. She now works with the Piltover enforcers.

entities.name: Vi (Arcane)
entities.summary: A Zaunite orphan raised by Vander and Powder's older sister. After years in Stillwater she fights beside Caitlyn and becomes her love interest.

entities.name: Viego
entities.summary: The king of Camavor whose attempt to revive his queen caused the Ruination. He returned as the Ruined King.

entities.name: Viktor
entities.summary: A Zaunite inventor and Jayce's former partner. He gave up his humanity for his Glorious Evolution.

entities.name: Viktor (Arcane)
entities.summary: A sick Zaunite scientist and Jayce's partner. Hextech and the hexcore transform him into the Herald of a Glorious Evolution.

entities.name: Vladimir
entities.summary: A blood mage who learned hemomancy from a Darkin. He has shaped Noxus since its earliest days.

entities.name: Volibear
entities.summary: The Freljordian demi-god of storms, known in myth as Valhir. He hates civilization.

entities.name: Warwick
entities.summary: A monster of Zaun, made by cruel experiments and fused with machines that pump rage into his veins.

entities.name: Waters of Life
entities.summary: Blessed waters on the Blessed Isles that could heal any ailment. Viego's attempt to use them to revive Isolde caused the Ruination.

entities.name: World Runes
entities.summary: Fragments of the raw magic that shaped the world. Their misuse caused the Rune Wars, and Ryze now hunts them to keep them safe.

entities.name: Xayah
entities.summary: A vastayan rebel who fights with feather blades beside her partner and lover Rakan.

entities.name: Xerath
entities.summary: A former slave who became an Ascended Magus by betraying Azir. He was sealed under the sands for millennia.

entities.name: Xin Zhao
entities.summary: A former Noxian pit fighter who swore loyalty to Demacia's royal family.

entities.name: Yasuo
entities.summary: An Ionian swordsman who was falsely accused of murdering his master and forced to kill his brother.

entities.name: Yone
entities.summary: Yasuo's half-brother, killed by him and then forced to wear a demon's mask in the spirit realm.

entities.name: Yorick
entities.summary: The last monk of a forgotten order on the Shadow Isles who can speak with the dead.

entities.name: Zaun
entities.summary: The undercity district in the canyons below Piltover, full of chemical smog and industry. It began as the old port of Oshra Va'Zaun and partly sank in the 772 AN disaster.

entities.name: Zed
entities.summary: The ruthless founder of the Order of Shadow, who uses forbidden shadow magic.

entities.name: Zeri
entities.summary: A spirited young woman from Zaun who uses electric magic.

entities.name: Zilean
entities.summary: An Icathian council member and time mage who pulled his tower and his people out of time when the Void came.

entities.name: Zoe
entities.summary: The playful Aspect of Twilight and a cosmic messenger of Targon.

events.title: Creation of the Universe
events.summary: Reality burst into the emptiness of the Void, and with it came the first Celestials such as Aurelion Sol and Bard. The expansion woke the Watchers, who resent the existence of everything.

events.title: Forging of Runeterra
events.summary: Unknown beings used the World Runes to shape Runeterra, which formed a physical realm and a spirit realm. Spirit gods, demons and the first yordles appeared, followed later by mortal races.

events.title: Titan War
events.summary: Mortals of Ionia fought sky-giants who came from above. Enlightened mortals took spirit power into themselves and became the Vastayashai'rei, the ancestors of the vastaya, and they won the war.

events.title: Lissandra's Pact with the Watchers
events.summary: Blinded by the demi-god Valhir, Lissandra reached the Watchers through dreamwalking. She traded near-immortality and rule of the Freljord for preparing the world for the Void, and the Three Sisters then fought the old gods.

events.title: War of the Three Sisters
events.summary: Avarosa and Serylda marched on Lissandra's citadel to resist serving the Watchers, just as the Watchers began to emerge. Lissandra sacrificed her sisters and their armies to entomb the Watchers in True Ice under the Howling Abyss.

events.title: Westward Migration
events.summary: Settlers from a lost eastern continent crossed to Shurima and Valoran over a thousand years. They founded the Buhru of the Serpent Isles, Helia on the Blessed Isles, Ixtal, the first Shuriman capital, the Targonian theocracy, Oshra Va'Zaun and Icathia.

events.title: Rise of the God-Warriors
events.summary: Guided by the Aspects of Targon, Shurimans used a Sun Disc to create the first Ascended. These god-warriors were worshipped as living gods and built an empire that lasted for millennia.

events.title: Shurima Conquers Icathia
events.summary: The Shuriman Ascended subjugated the mage kingdom of Icathia and killed its mage king Axamuk. Shurima then banned the worship of any deity except the Ascended.

events.title: Icathian Rebellion and the Void War
events.summary: Icathia rebelled against Shurima and tried to weaponize the Void, but tore open a huge rift that destroyed its own capital. Ascended and Voidborn fought a long war, and Zilean pulled his tower full of refugees out of time.

events.title: Fall of the Monolith
events.summary: The Ixtali god-warrior Ne'Zuk built the Monolith, a floating fortress, to fight the Void in Icathia. It crashed into the rift, and its last surviving shard later became Malphite.

events.title: Fall of Shurima
events.summary: Xerath disrupted Azir's Ascension ritual, killed the emperor and ascended in his place. The magical fallout destroyed the capital and buried it and the Sun Disc under the sands. Xerath and Renekton were sealed in the Tomb of the Emperors, and Nasus went into exile.

events.title: Rise of the Darkin
events.summary: With no emperor and no Void to fight, many surviving Ascended became tyrants who enslaved mortals. People called them the Darkin, and they began to war with each other.

events.title: Vladimir Learns Blood Magic
events.summary: Vladimir's father gave him to a Darkin to protect Camavor. The Darkin made Vladimir the first human blood mage, and Vladimir destroyed his father's kingdom on his master's orders.

events.title: End of the Great Darkin War
events.summary: Mortals given knowledge by the Aspects sealed the remaining Darkin, including Aatrox and Rhaast, inside their own weapons. Varus was the last to be sealed, in his bow, which ended the war.

events.title: Mordekaiser Reborn
events.summary: Sorcerers raised the dead warlord Sahn-Uzal in a body of dark iron, hoping to use him as a weapon. He killed them, took the name Mordekaiser and began building an empire around the Immortal Bastion.

events.title: Veigar Imprisoned in the Bastion
events.summary: Mordekaiser captured the curious yordle Veigar among a group of Noxii star mages. He bound Veigar to the physical plane and forced him to make dark spells for centuries.

events.title: LeBlanc and Vladimir Found the Black Rose
events.summary: During Mordekaiser's reign, a LeBlanc visited the blood mage Vladimir on the cliffs of eastern Valoran. Their meeting and shared dark magic became the basis of the Black Rose, with LeBlanc as its matron.

events.title: Fall of Mordekaiser
events.summary: An alliance of Noxii tribes, aided by a LeBlanc from his own inner circle, cut his soul from his armor and hid the empty shell. His soul went to the realm of the dead, and the Noxii inherited his empire.

events.title: Poisoning of Queen Isolde
events.summary: Plotters sent an assassin against the new king Viego. Kalista saved him, but the poisoned blade struck his queen Isolde, and Viego sent Kalista to find the Waters of Life.

events.title: Kalista Reaches the Blessed Isles
events.summary: With the help of Tyrus and his apprentice Ryze, Kalista passed the mists and pleaded with the masters of Helia, who refused her. Erlok Grael secretly offered her the Waters of Life and a waystone in exchange for influence in Camavor.

events.title: The Ruination
events.summary: Viego came to Helia with Isolde's body, and Hecarim's knights sacked the city and killed Kalista. Isolde woke as a wraith in the Well of Ages and stabbed Viego, and the unstable World Rune below released a blast that turned the Blessed Isles into the Shadow Isles under the Black Mist.

events.title: Destruction of Khom
events.summary: Two Noxii nations parleyed with Tyrus at the village of Khom, and the encounter ended with two World Runes destroying the region. It was the first great attack of the Rune Wars, witnessed by Ryze.

events.title: Birth of Kayle and Morgana
events.summary: Seeking divine help during the Rune Wars, the pregnant Mihira climbed Mount Targon and became the host of the Aspect of Justice. She gave birth to the twins Kayle and Morgana that year.

events.title: Ixtal Seals Its Borders
events.summary: As the Rune Wars came near, Skarner persuaded the Yun Tal to draw the wilderness around Ixaocan as a shield. Ixtal cut itself off from the rest of Runeterra.

events.title: Ryze Kills Tyrus
events.summary: When Tyrus tried to use two World Runes for himself, his apprentice Ryze confronted and killed him. Ryze vowed never to use a World Rune and to keep them all from misuse.

events.title: Refugees Found Demacia
events.summary: Refugees from the Rune Wars found shelter in forests of magic-nullifying petricite in western Valoran. There they built Zeffira, the first Demacian city.

events.title: Noxus Endures
events.summary: The last Noxii sheltered from the magical fallout inside the Immortal Bastion. When they came out they united as one people, Noxus, and they date their calendar from this moment.

events.title: Kayle and Morgana Leave Demacia
events.summary: The twins defended young Demacia, but their trust broke. Their battle over the city ended when their father Kilam died, after which Kayle went to Targon and Morgana stayed in the wilds. Demacia kept their image as its crest.

events.title: The Demacian Crown
events.summary: The nation founded by the champion Orlon crowned its first king and declared itself a sanctuary from magic forever.

events.title: Durand Builds Galio
events.summary: Demacia asked the sculptor Durand for a moving petricite shield. He built Galio, a winged colossus that stopped an invading order of war-mages and then went still.

events.title: Noxus Becomes an Imperial Power
events.summary: After forced annexations and the fall of the Drakkengate, the noble houses vowed to unite all of Runeterra under one banner. They chose a Grand General to lead their armies.

events.title: Tragedy on the River Pilt
events.summary: Oshra Va'Zaun used chemtech bombs to cut a sea passage through the isthmus. The blasts set off earthquakes that sank whole districts and released poison gas, and the wind spirit Janna saved many people.

events.title: Founding of Bilgewater
events.summary: Buhru missionaries let fortune seekers from Demacia, the Freljord and Ionia settle in the southern bays of the Serpent Isles. The settlement grew into Bilgewater.

events.title: Sun Gates Open; Piltover Rises
events.summary: The rebuilt city built the Sun Gates to control the new sea passage. The wealth from them created a merchant district over the Pilt River, named Piltover, and Progress Day marks the gates' opening.

events.title: Sion Kills King Jarvan I
events.summary: As Demacia drove the Noxian warbands back to Hvardis, Sion threw his commander from the walls and charged. Pierced many times, he strangled King Jarvan I before he died, and Demacia retreated.

events.title: Noxus Expands South
events.summary: Grand General Darkwill pushed Noxus toward the Great Barrier and annexed Basilich. Minotaurs who refused to ally, like Alistar, went to the arenas, and the orphans Darius and Draven joined the army.

events.title: Xin Zhao Joins Demacia
events.summary: Noxus sent conscripted pit fighters against the rebel fortress of Kalstead. Demacia beat them and spared them, and the reckoner Xin Zhao swore loyalty to King Jarvan III as his guard.

events.title: Capture of Khada Jhin
events.summary: Master Kusho, Shen and Zed tracked the serial killer Jhin for years. They caught him at Jyom Pass and imprisoned him in Tuula.

events.title: Noxian Invasion of Ionia
events.summary: Grand General Boram Darkwill ordered a large-scale occupation of Ionia. Resistance grew after Admiral Duqal's forces killed Irelia's family and she found the war power of her dances.

events.title: Zed Takes the Tears of Shadow
events.summary: Banished for learning forbidden shadow techniques, Zed returned to the Kinkou temple and took the Tears of Shadow. He and Kusho staged Kusho's death, and Zed formed the Order of Shadow.

events.title: Kai'Sa Lost to the Void
events.summary: A Void rift opened in Kai'Sa's village and the earth swallowed it under the Sai desert. The child survived when a voidling fused to her skin, and her father Kassadin thought he had lost her.

events.title: Chemical Attack at Navori
events.summary: Singed's chem-bombs, brought by Riven's warband, killed everyone on both sides and destroyed Master Yi's village. In the aftermath Riven caused Elder Souma's death by accident, and Yasuo was blamed for the murder.

events.title: Ashe Finds the True Ice Bow
events.summary: On her mother's quest for Avarosa's Throne, Ashe lost her tribe to an ambush. At the end of the maps she found a bow of True Ice and later founded a new Avarosan tribe after breaking with Sejuani.

events.title: Evelynn Kills Vayne's Parents
events.summary: The demon Evelynn murdered Shauna Vayne's parents. Vayne vowed to learn all about dark magic to take revenge.

events.title: Trifarian Revolution
events.summary: The disgraced general Jericho Swain, with Draven, General Du Couteau and others, staged a coup in the capital and killed Boram Darkwill. Within a year Swain ended most of the occupation of Ionia and set up the Trifarix council.

events.title: Battle of Dalu Bay
events.summary: Irelia's forces won a decisive victory over Admiral Duqal and ended the invasion. She then left the leadership of the resistance, and groups like the Order of Shadow fought for power.

events.title: The Tomb of the Emperors Opened
events.summary: Cassiopeia betrayed Sivir and used her blade as a key to the tomb. The guardian's curse turned Cassiopeia into a serpent, and Xerath and Renekton were freed.

events.title: Rebirth of the Sun Disc
events.summary: Sivir's blood, the last of Azir's line, restored Azir. He saved her life at the Oasis of the Dawn, became an Ascended, and raised the Sun Disc and his capital from the sands.

events.title: Shyvana Saves Jarvan IV
events.summary: Prince Jarvan IV was encircled and defeated beyond the Argent Mountains. The half-dragon Shyvana found him, carried him to safety, and killed her dragon mother Yvva to protect him.

events.title: Thresh Takes Senna
events.summary: While Senna and Lucian searched a vault for a cure to her curse, Thresh attacked. Senna stepped in front of her husband, and Thresh sealed her soul in his lantern.

events.title: Fall of Gangplank
events.summary: Sarah Fortune took her revenge on the reaver king who had killed her parents by blowing up his flagship. Six months after his fall she removed several corrupt leaders and began to take control of Bilgewater.

events.title: The Harrowing of Bilgewater
events.summary: Hecarim and Thresh led a Harrowing against Bilgewater. Illaoi called on Nagakabouros to drive it back, and Lucian learned that Senna's soul was trapped in Thresh's lantern.

events.title: Lucian Frees Senna
events.summary: Lucian went to the heart of the Shadow Isles, fought Thresh and freed Senna's soul from the lantern. She came back as a wraith and saved him with a relic cannon.

events.title: Annie Awakens Tibbers
events.summary: Annie's grief over her family set off a fire that burned her home. When her guardian tried to tear apart her bear, Annie's rage transformed Tibbers.

events.title: Yasuo Meets Yone
events.summary: In Weh'le an azakana demon tried to feed on Yasuo's guilt. A masked swordsman, his brother Yone back from the dead, helped him defeat it, and Yasuo made peace with him.

events.title: Syndra Breaks Free
events.summary: Syndra was freed from her prison at Fae'lor and lifted the ruined castle into the sky. The loss of this Noxian fort pushed Noxus to prepare a second invasion of Ionia.

events.title: Kayn Claims Rhaast
events.summary: Kayn of the Order of Shadow took up the Darkin scythe Rhaast and began a struggle for control of his own body.

events.title: Zed Kills Master Kusho
events.summary: Zed learned that Kusho, now head of the Navori Brotherhood, had freed Jhin. Kusho took the Tears of Shadow and fought, but Zed killed him and, with Kayn's help, took back the Order of Shadow.

events.title: Sylas Escapes; the Mage Rebellion
events.summary: Sylas used Lux's magic to escape his execution, freed imprisoned mages and charged the palace. His escape started a mage revolt in Demacia.

events.title: Assassination of King Jarvan III
events.summary: Jarvan III tried to calm the crisis by ordering the Mageseekers to stop rounding up mages. An intruder, later revealed as Katarina, killed him in the palace, and Jarvan IV vowed to bring all mages to justice.

events.title: Galio Answers Lux
events.summary: Sylas led Winter's Claw raiders against Garen, Lux and the Demacian army at a northern fortress. As Sylas was about to strike Garen, Lux used her magic to summon Galio, and the army rallied around him.

events.title: Defeat of the Ruined King
events.summary: Viego, aided by Thresh and Vex, gathered the pieces of Isolde's soul. The Sentinels of Light fought him on the Shadow Isles and in Camavor, and he was defeated and sealed in Alovedra, but Thresh took control of the Black Mist.

events.title: Kai'Sa Meets Bel'Veth
events.summary: After Bel'Veth swallowed a Shuriman port city, Kai'Sa fell into the Lavender Sea and was captured by her. Bel'Veth revealed that Kassadin still lives and demanded that Kai'Sa help her destroy the Watchers.

events.title: Ezreal and Kai'Sa in the Tomb
events.summary: Ezreal raided a Shuriman tomb for the Tear of the Goddess and woke voidlings. Kai'Sa stepped in to save him, and they fought the Voidborn together.

events.title: Season 1: Burning Bright
events.summary: Empowered by the First Star, high schooler Lux and her team (Janna, Jinx, Lulu and Poppy) secretly protect Valoran City from interstellar monsters while dealing with school drama.

events.title: Season 2: A New Horizon
events.summary: Veterans Ahri and Miss Fortune return to Valoran City with a rebuilt team after an unknown event destroyed their first squad. They fight alongside Lux's team as Void beasts fall on the city.

events.title: K/DA Debuts with 'POP/STARS'
events.summary: K/DA was unveiled at the 2018 World Championship opening ceremony in Incheon with an augmented reality performance of 'POP/STARS'. The music video went viral and topped Billboard's World Digital Song Sales chart.

events.title: Season 3: Light and Shadow
events.summary: Ahri's old squad returns, changed by what tore them apart, and brings a threat greater than any before: Zoe, corrupted into the Twilight Star.

events.title: Pre-release Single 'THE BADDEST'
events.summary: K/DA returned with 'THE BADDEST', the pre-release single for its first EP. It is K/DA Akali's solo song on the record.

events.title: 'MORE' with Seraphine
events.summary: The lead single 'MORE' featured all four members plus Seraphine as a guest vocalist. It was the first virtual band song to debut on the Billboard Global 200 and Global Excl. U.S. charts at the same time.

events.title: ALL OUT EP Released
events.summary: K/DA released its five-track debut EP ALL OUT. In the fiction each song was produced by one member, except 'MORE', and Seraphine helped produce the record.

events.title: The Failed Undercity Uprising
events.summary: Vander led Zaun's people across the bridge against Piltover, and the fighting killed many, including Vi and Powder's parents. Vander gave up fighting and took in the orphaned sisters.

events.title: The Piltover Heist
events.summary: Vi led Powder, Mylo and Claggor in a raid on an inventor's apartment, and a stolen crystal blew up. The workshop belonged to Jayce, who was put on trial for his illegal magic research and expelled from the Academy.

events.title: Vander Captured by Silco
events.summary: Vander surrendered to the enforcers in Vi's place, but Silco's shimmer-boosted thug Deckard killed Benzo and took Vander. Silco revealed the shimmer he had made for a war against Piltover.

events.title: Birth of Hextech
events.summary: Viktor helped Jayce stabilize the magic crystals, and in Heimerdinger's lab they made the first working hextech reaction. Councilor Medarda saw it, and Jayce named the new era Hextech.

events.title: Powder's Bomb and Silco's Adoption
events.summary: Powder's crystal bomb freed Vander from Silco's factory but killed Mylo and Claggor. Vi turned on her and was taken away by Marcus, and Silco, moved by Powder's grief, took her in as his daughter.

events.title: Jayce Joins the Council
events.summary: Years later, after a hextech gemstone theft and a Progress Day crisis, Mel proposed raising Jayce to the Council, and the councilors agreed. Jayce later had Heimerdinger removed from the Council.

events.title: The Monster You Created
events.summary: Jinx made Vi choose between Powder and Jinx, with Silco and Caitlyn bound at the table. In a panic she killed Silco and then fired a gemstone-powered rocket at the Council chamber as it voted for Zaun's independence.

events.title: Season 4: Everything Goes On
events.summary: In a Valoran City scarred by Zoe's invasion, Kai'Sa and Akali lead an untested new team, while a redeemed Xayah leads another. Ancient enemies such as the Star Nemeses rise.

events.title: Aftermath of the Council Attack
events.summary: The rocket killed several councilors, including Caitlyn's mother. Jayce saved the dying Viktor with the hexcore, and Caitlyn formed an enforcer strike team to hunt Jinx while Ambessa pushed for war.

events.title: The Black Rose Strikes at Ambessa
events.summary: A Black Rose agent tried to assassinate Ambessa on her flagship, but her bodyguard broke the spell and Ambessa killed her. Ambessa then sped up her plans for Piltover.

events.title: Vander Lives as Warwick
events.summary: Jinx told Vi that Vander was alive, turned by Singed into the beast Warwick. Viktor tried to draw Vander's mind back out of Warwick at his commune, but Ambessa's forces attacked.

events.title: Ekko in Another World
events.summary: Ekko woke in a timeline where hextech was never invented, Powder never became Jinx, and Piltover and Zaun were at peace. That world's Heimerdinger sacrificed himself to send Ekko home.

events.title: Viktor's Glorious Evolution
events.summary: Kept alive with Warwick's blood, Viktor woke able to control his followers and named their union the Glorious Evolution. He agreed to change Ambessa's soldiers in return for reaching the anomaly under the hexgates.

events.title: The Battle for Piltover
events.summary: Noxus, Piltover and Zaun fought at the hexgate tower, and Mel freed Ambessa from LeBlanc's magic in time to hear her last words. Jayce stayed with Viktor as he undid his Evolution and both vanished into the arcane, while Jinx dragged Warwick off the walkway with her and set off a grenade.

events.title: A Shared Memorial and a New Council
events.summary: Piltover and Zaun held a joint memorial on the bridge, and the reformed Council included Sevika. Mel left for Noxus with her mother's forces, and Caitlyn began to suspect that Jinx survived.

events.title: Return with FIRESTARTER
events.summary: After a long gap, K/DA returned with the title track 'FIRESTARTER' and an EP of the same name. Evelynn and Kai'Sa have new singing voices, and the song 'Girls' features DJ Sona.
